properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the Ethereum transaction-signing curve: every Wallet/Signer in this Hardhat/zksync template signs with ECDSA over secp256k1. Declared deps (@noble/secp256k1@1.7.1, secp256k1@4.0.5, @types/secp256k1) plus pnpm-workspace.yaml:9 allowBuilds grant for the native secp256k1 package. Classical, Shor-vulnerable; the whole Ethereum signing stack shares this deadline.

properties.name: pqs:context

Declared deps keccak@3.0.4 (native) and @ethersproject/keccak256@5.8.0, plus pnpm-workspace.yaml:6 allowBuilds for the native keccak package. Grover-only exposure, not urgent.

properties.name: pqs:context
